p1: 3 a.m., Saturday. The elevator opened on my floor, packed with people, all facing the wall.
Except one. A man in a black suit, smiling right at me.
There was one gap. I said, no thanks... and took the stairs.
As the doors closed, he said...
Mrs Hale from 14B leaves biscuits at my door every Sunday. This Sunday, nothing.
She'd died in her sleep. At 3 a.m.
That night, the elevator came back. Mrs Hale was in it... standing in the gap.
That was five nights ago. Five neighbours. Every time I say no... someone fills the gap.
Tonight he looked past me, at my door. My girlfriend Emma's asleep inside.
The doors are still open. He's waiting.
